record.bible_text: <FO><FO>Michtam<WH04387> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Preserve<WH08104><WTH8798> me, O God<WH0410>: for in thee do I put my trust<WH02620><WTH8804>. <RF>Michtam: or, A golden Psalm<Rf>
<FI> O my soul<Fi> , thou hast said<WH0559><WTH8804> unto the LORD<WH03068>, Thou <FI>art<Fi> my Lord<WH0136>: my goodness<WH02896> <FI>extendeth<Fi> not to thee;
<FI> But<Fi> to the saints<WH06918> that<WH01992> <FI>are<Fi> in the earth<WH0776>, and <FI>to<Fi> the excellent<WH0117>, in whom <FI>is<Fi> all my delight<WH02656>.

Their sorrows<WH06094> shall be multiplied<WH07235><WTH8799> <FI>that<Fi> hasten<WH04116><WTH8804> <FI>after<Fi> another<WH0312> <FI>god<Fi> : their drink offerings<WH05262> of blood<WH01818> will I not offer<WH05258><WTH8686>, nor<WH01077> take up<WH05375><WTH8799> their names<WH08034> into my lips<WH08193>. <RF>hasten...: or, give gifts to another<Rf>
The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> the portion<WH04490> of mine inheritance<WH02506> and of my cup<WH03563>: thou maintainest<WH08551><WTH8802> my lot<WH01486>. <RF>of mine...: Heb. of my part<Rf>
The lines<WH02256> are fallen<WH05307><WTH8804> unto me in pleasant<WH05273> <FI>places<Fi> ; yea, I have a goodly<WH08231><WTH8804> heritage<WH05159>.
I will bless<WH01288><WTH8762> the LORD<WH03068>, who hath given me counsel<WH03289><WTH8804>: my reins<WH03629> also instruct<WH03256><WTH8765> me in the night seasons<WH03915>.<CM>
I have set<WH07737><WTH8765> the LORD<WH03068> always<WH08548> before me: because <FI>he is<Fi> at my right hand<WH03225>, I shall not be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>.

Therefore my heart<WH03820> is glad<WH08055><WTH8804>, and my glory<WH03519> rejoiceth<WH01523><WTH8799>: my flesh<WH01320> also shall rest<WH07931><WTH8799> in hope<WH0983>. <RF>rest...: Heb. dwell confidently<Rf>
For thou wilt not leave<WH05800><WTH8799> my soul<WH05315> in hell<WH07585>; neither wilt thou suffer<WH05414><WTH8799> thine Holy One<WH02623> to see<WH07200><WTH8800> corruption<WH07845>.

Thou wilt shew<WH03045><WTH8686> me the path<WH0734> of life<WH02416>: in thy presence<WH06440> <FI>is<Fi> fulness<WH07648> of joy<WH08057>; at thy right hand<WH03225> <FI>there are<Fi> pleasures<WH05273> for evermore<WH05331>.<CM>
